name: Cell Detection with Star-convex Polygons
description: Schmidt, Weigert, Broaddus & Myers (2018), MICCAI; preprint arXiv:1806.03535. StarDist detects cell nuclei in fluorescence microscopy images as star-convex polygons. Crate described by ReCRATE from the paper and its code: the paper's own trained model (StarDist 2D_paper_dsb2018), its test images with ground truth (the DSB2018 subset the authors released), and Table 1's average precision.

methods.name: stardist_ap
methods.description: Table 1, DSB2018: average precision of StarDist at IoU thresholds 0.5 to 0.9, with the model trained in the paper, on the paper's 50 test images and their manual annotations.

inputs.name: input_dir
inputs.description: images/ (fluorescence, one nucleus channel) and masks/ (ground-truth labels, the same names)

inputs.name: prob_thresh
inputs.description: Object probability threshold for candidate polygons (the model's published thresholds)
inputs.quote: We only consider polygons associated with pixels above an object probability threshold as candidates

inputs.name: nms_thresh
inputs.description: Overlap threshold of the non-maximum suppression (the model's published thresholds)
inputs.quote: We perform common, greedy non-maximum suppression

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Average precision at each IoU threshold

ap.note: Table 1 prints four decimals: half a unit of the last decimal

methods.expected_source: Table 1 of the paper, DSB2018, StarDist (Ours) row

methods.name: segment_nuclei
methods.description: StarDist nuclei segmentation with the paper's model, for any fluorescence nuclei images: each image's nuclei (label masks), their number and mean size; with ground truth beside the images (masks/), also its average precision at IoU 0.5.

inputs.name: input_dir
inputs.description: Fluorescence images of nuclei, one channel (in the folder or in images/); optional ground truth in masks/

inputs.name: prob_thresh
inputs.description: Object probability threshold for candidate polygons (the model's published thresholds)
inputs.quote: We only consider polygons associated with pixels above an object probability threshold as candidates

inputs.name: nms_thresh
inputs.description: Overlap threshold of the non-maximum suppression (the model's published thresholds)
inputs.quote: We perform common, greedy non-maximum suppression

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Resize factor before prediction, so nuclei have the size in pixels the model was trained on: 2 for images whose pixels are twice the paper's

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Per image: count, mean area in pixels; with ground truth, its count and AP at IoU 0.5
